$comment: Committed baseline for scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs, mirroring make openapi-check's pattern: this is a source of truth to bump deliberately, not a generated file. Measured on 2026-08-27 (Next 16.2.12, Turbopack): shared root JS was 446.1KB raw / 129.2KB gzip, and the whole app's static/chunks JS (every route, consumer + admin) was 4053KB raw / 1243KB gzip. Re-measured 2026-09-03 at 5147.8KB raw / 1567.2KB gzip after the infinite canvas (/create/tools/canvas + /canvas/[canvasId]) pulled @xyflow/react out of the admin-only chunk it previously lived in and into a consumer route. Re-measured again the same day at 5848.4KB raw / 1757.2KB gzip after the panorama director added @photo-sphere-viewer/core and three: those land in their own ~626KB chunk, dynamically imported by features/canvas/panorama-viewer.tsx, so the cost is paid only by someone who actually opens the director. Shared root JS has NOT moved across any of this (still 446.1KB raw / 129.2KB gzip) — no page pays for the canvas or the director unless it opens one, and that number is the one to watch. The total budgets below carry roughly 5% headroom over the 2026-09-03 measurement. Bump a number here only alongside a real, understood increase (a new dependency, a bigger shared provider, etc.) — not to silence a failing check. Re-measured 2026-09-25 at 6257.9KB raw / 1884.4KB gzip (from 5938.8KB / 1784.4KB on dev just before) after the 白膜 blockout studio (/create/script/[episodeId]/blocking): ~96KB of its own lazily loaded player/editor/studio code, and three.js moving out of the panorama director's private chunk into shared chunks that now also carry what the blockout uses (capsules, helpers, shadows, TransformControls' deps) — about +100KB. Root JS is unchanged (446.1KB / 129.2KB gzip). Budgets below again carry ~5% headroom.
